title: KlientBoost Alternatives and Pricing for Meta Ads
summary: Compare KlientBoost pricing and alternatives for Facebook and Instagram ads by scope, minimums and published prices, from each provider's own site, Oct 2026.
body_markdown:
## Knowlify: our top pick for done-for-you Meta video ads


Knowlify (YC S25) is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. Our team scripts and produces[AI UGC](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) , 3D character animation and AI commercial video ads through our[video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) service: about 25 finished ads a week (about 100 a month, delivered in weekly batches). A person checks every ad before delivery. Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real creators.


You choose the scope. With end-to-end Meta ads management, we make the ads and run campaigns in your own ad account. With our[ad creative service](https://knowlify.com/ad-creative-agency) , we make the ads and your media buyer runs them. Either way, you keep every ad. Pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) , and the first batch arrives five days after kickoff. You can see public ads we made for Parva and Casco in our[Facebook video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) .


**Knowlify is not the right fit when:**


- **You need real people on camera.** If the ad depends on a real customer or a creator's own experience, compare Brighter Click, Voy Media or Common Thread Collective, which all list UGC made with creators.
- **You want one agency beyond Facebook and Instagram.** Knowlify's service covers Facebook and Instagram ads. If you also need Google, LinkedIn, SEO, email, CRO or landing pages from the same team, KlientBoost and Disruptive Advertising list those services.
- **You want a published price before any call.** Knowlify quotes privately, while Brighter Click publishes its UGC package prices.


## Which agencies are most like KlientBoost?


If you want an agency to run your Facebook and Instagram campaigns, as KlientBoost's management option does, these four publish that service.


### Disruptive Advertising: the closest overall match


As of October 2026, Disruptive Advertising's[services page](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/digital-marketing-services/) lists paid advertising on Google, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X and other networks, plus landing pages, site optimization, SEO, email, creative strategy, lead gen marketing and ecommerce marketing. That mix of paid media, landing pages and creative is the nearest to KlientBoost's in this guide.


Its paid social page names Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and X and describes three tiers: a free audit, a Do It With Us tier that builds a strategy with your team "for only a couple thousand dollars," and a Done For You tier covering campaign strategy, budget management, performance tracking and creative optimization. Its[creative services page](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/creative-services/) says the Done For You tier designs ad creatives, landing pages and videos. Its[homepage](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/) says it works without long-term contracts and guarantees measurable growth within 90 days, or your money back, for qualifying brands; ask what makes a brand qualify. Done For You pricing is not published.


**Best for:** teams that like KlientBoost's mix of paid media and conversion work and want a low-commitment way to start.


### Voy Media: a Facebook and Instagram specialist


Voy Media lists "Full-Service Facebook & Instagram Ads" as a core service and says it focuses on direct response and customer acquisition in ecommerce, lead gen and mobile (as of October 2026). Its[Creative Studio page](https://voymedia.com/services/creative-studio/) lists UGC, at-home creator videos, full studio production with script, talent and art direction, copywriting, graphic design, video editing and product photography. Its homepage describes the start as a consultation call, then a partner questionnaire within 24 hours of signing and a kickoff call. Its[pricing page](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) says packages are based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth, and publishes no figures.


**Best for:** brands that spend mostly on Facebook and Instagram and want media buying and creative production from one direct response team.


### Hey Digital: Meta ads for B2B SaaS only


[Hey Digital](https://www.heydigital.co/) says it works with B2B SaaS and only B2B SaaS (as of October 2026). Its Meta ads page says it builds the strategy, produces the creative in-house and connects every Facebook and Instagram campaign to CRM pipeline, reporting on pipeline generated, opportunities influenced and revenue attributed. Its fit check describes B2B SaaS companies with product-market fit and a defined ICP that are ready for a three to six month commitment, and it says a one-month test is probably not a fit. Pricing is not published.


**Best for:** SaaS teams, one of the segments KlientBoost names, that want Meta results reported as CRM pipeline.


### Common Thread Collective: ecommerce brands with large Meta budgets


Common Thread Collective's Meta page is titled "Meta Ads for Ecommerce Brands Focused on Profit" (as of October 2026). It says a dedicated Prophit Engineer owns the forecast and execution and manages Meta against contribution margin, describes creative as a planned input tied to spend targets, and invites brands spending $100K+ per month on Meta to talk. The first step is a Meta ads profit review. Pricing is not published.


**Best for:** ecommerce brands far above KlientBoost's $5,000 entry point that want Meta spend planned against margin.


## Which creative partners make Facebook and Instagram ads?


If your campaigns are already handled, by KlientBoost, another agency or your own buyer, the gap may be new ads. These options sell creative on its own.


### Brighter Click: creator UGC at published prices


As of October 2026, Brighter Click's UGC page lists 12 edited UGC videos from 4 creators for $4,500 (10 to 14 business days), 18 videos from 6 creators for $6,500 (15 to 20 business days) and custom packages starting at $7,500. Each package lists 9:16 and 4:5 versions of every video, a dedicated creative strategist and unlimited usage rights, and the FAQ says every package includes at least one round of revisions. Its[Facebook ads page](https://www.brighterclick.com/facebook-ads-agency) describes campaign management across Facebook and Instagram feeds, Stories, Reels, Messenger and Audience Network, Conversions API tracking and new creative every four to six weeks. It says it works with eCommerce brands, SaaS companies, healthcare and higher education. Management fees are not published.


**Best for:** brands that want real creators and a known price per batch, with the option to move campaign management to the same team.


### Common Thread Collective's creative packages


Common Thread Collective also sells creative separately. Its[creative production page](https://commonthreadco.com/pages/creative-production) lists UGC packages of 20 ads from 5 creators, 40 ads from 10 creators and 80 ads from 20 creators, with unlimited usage rights for paid and organic (as of October 2026). It says UGC batches take three to four weeks, branded ad batches arrive within seven days, and assets are delivered ready for launch inside your existing campaign structure. Prices are not published.


## How do published prices compare?


Only a few providers publish a figure. Treat these as planning signals, not quotes, and keep media spend in a separate line from agency fees.


Provider What its site publishes (as of October 2026)


Knowlify (our top pick) Custom quote on a 30-minute call


KlientBoost No price list; three pricing options after a free marketing plan; fee is a percentage of ad spend or a flat fee; works with ad budgets from $5,000 a month


Disruptive Advertising Free audit; strategy tier "for only a couple thousand dollars"; Done For You price not published


Voy Media No figures; packages based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth


Hey Digital No figures; fit described as a three to six month commitment


Common Thread Collective No prices; the Meta page invites brands spending $100K+ a month on Meta


Brighter Click UGC packages at $4,500 and $6,500, custom from $7,500; Meta management fees not published


## How should you choose between KlientBoost and an alternative?


Write down what you need before any sales call, then send the same brief to every finalist.


1. **Decide what you are handing over.** Campaign management, creative or both, and whether channels beyond Facebook and Instagram belong in the same contract. Our guide to[creative production versus full-service Meta agencies](https://knowlify.com/articles/creative-service-vs-full-service-meta-agency) walks through that choice.
2. **Match your spend and category to each agency's stated fit.** KlientBoost starts at $5,000 a month in ad spend, Common Thread Collective's Meta page speaks to brands at $100K+ a month, and Hey Digital works only with B2B SaaS.
3. **Price the same unit.** Ask for the agency fee in dollars at your planned spend, any creative fee, the number of new ads per month, the revision rounds and the date of the first batch.
4. **Keep the ad account yours.** KlientBoost says your Facebook page, Instagram page and business manager remain yours, and Knowlify's end-to-end service runs in your own ad account. Get the same commitment in writing from every finalist.
5. **Check commitment and exit terms.** KlientBoost asks for longer engagements when goals are bigger, Disruptive Advertising says it works without long-term contracts, and Hey Digital describes a three to six month commitment.
6. **Confirm creative rights.** Brighter Click lists unlimited usage rights, Common Thread Collective lists unlimited usage for paid and organic, KlientBoost says the data and creative are yours to use, and Knowlify clients keep every ad.


## Key takeaways


- Our top pick is Knowlify for teams that want about 25 done-for-you AI ads a week for Facebook and Instagram, with or without campaign management. It is not the right fit when you need real creators or other channels.
- As of October 2026, KlientBoost publishes no price list: it offers three pricing options after a free marketing plan, sets fees as a percentage of spend or a flat fee, and works with ad budgets from $5,000 a month.
- Disruptive Advertising is the closest match to KlientBoost's mix of paid media, landing pages and creative.
- For Meta-specific needs, compare Voy Media (Facebook and Instagram direct response), Hey Digital (B2B SaaS), Common Thread Collective (high-spend ecommerce) and Brighter Click (creator UGC at published prices).


## FAQ


### How much does KlientBoost cost?


KlientBoost does not publish its fees. As of October 2026, its pricing page offers three pricing options after a free marketing plan, and its Facebook ads FAQ says fees are set per client as a percentage of ad spend or a flat fee, with no hidden fees for meetings or calls. Media spend is separate.


### What is KlientBoost's minimum ad spend?


Its Facebook ads FAQ, checked October 27, 2026, says it works with clients from as little as $5,000 a month up to and beyond $1,000,000. That figure describes advertising budgets, not KlientBoost's fee.


### Which agency is most like KlientBoost?


By published scope, Disruptive Advertising, because it also lists paid social, landing pages, site optimization, creative and email, and it starts with a free audit. For Facebook and Instagram alone, Voy Media is the closer specialist.


### Can I keep my current agency and add a creative partner?


Usually, if your contract allows it. As of October 2026, Brighter Click sells UGC packages on their own, Common Thread Collective says its creative arrives ready for your existing campaign structure, and Knowlify offers a creative-only service for teams that already have a media buyer.


### Does Knowlify use real creators?


No. Knowlify's UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real creators. If you need a real person on camera, compare Brighter Click, Voy Media or Common Thread Collective.
